attributes.name: single_arm_moves
attributes.text: Only one arm carries the motion while the other arm stays still.
attributes.definition: One arm (usually the right) clearly moves while the other arm stays at the side or still, and the legs do not carry the motion.

attributes.name: both_arms_mirror
attributes.text: Both arms make the same motion at the same time, mirrored left and right.
attributes.definition: The left and right arms move together with matching, mirrored paths throughout most of the action.

attributes.name: one_hand_holds_other_works
attributes.text: One hand stays still as a base while the other hand moves near it.
attributes.definition: Both hands are close together in front of the body; one (usually left) stays nearly still while the other makes repeated or directed motions near it.

attributes.name: hands_move_arms_still
attributes.text: Small motion is at the hands and wrists while the upper arms stay still.
attributes.definition: Visible motion is mainly in the hand and wrist joints, with the elbows and shoulders nearly fixed.

attributes.name: forearm_swings_upper_arm_still
attributes.text: The forearm swings from the elbow while the upper arm stays fixed.
attributes.definition: The elbow acts as the pivot: the forearm and hand move back and forth while the upper arm barely moves.

attributes.name: head_carries_motion
attributes.text: The head is the main moving part.
attributes.definition: The largest visible motion is a movement of the head relative to the shoulders, with the arms mostly passive.

attributes.name: legs_carry_motion
attributes.text: The legs carry the main motion.
attributes.definition: The largest movement is in the knees, ankles and feet, with the arms only following or balancing.

attributes.name: one_leg_moves
attributes.text: One leg moves while the other leg supports the body.
attributes.definition: A single leg lifts and moves through the main motion while the other stays planted.

attributes.name: torso_carries_motion
attributes.text: The torso bends or turns as a main part of the motion.
attributes.definition: The spine joints move clearly (bending forward, twisting or leaning), not only as a small follow of arm motion.

attributes.name: arms_and_legs_together
attributes.text: Arms and legs move together in a coordinated way.
attributes.definition: Both the arms and the legs show large motion during the same phase of the action.

attributes.name: shoulders_move
attributes.text: The shoulders lift, roll or drop visibly.
attributes.definition: The shoulder joints move relative to the spine (shrug, roll back, drop on one side, or round inward).

attributes.name: left_arm_leads
attributes.text: The left arm carries the main motion.
attributes.definition: The left arm makes the largest or first directed movement, while the right arm is passive or only assists.
